name: Configuration Integrity Baseline
description: Establishes and monitors configuration baselines for agents, tools, and MCP servers. Detects unauthorized configuration changes that could weaken security posture or introduce vulnerabilities.
threat_addressed: If agent configurations, policy files, or tool settings are modified without detection, the entire security posture can be silently undermined.
enforcement_mechanism: Agent configurations, policy files, and tool settings are baselined with integrity hashes. Changes detected through continuous monitoring. Unauthorized changes trigger alerts and remediation.

security_outcome.pass: Monitoring covers all configuration files. Baselines current. Hash comparison continuous. Alerts within defined window.

display_detail: Monitors agent and tool configurations against established baselines to detect unauthorized changes.
remediation_hint_template: Configuration drift detected. Review recent configuration changes and re-establish baseline if changes are authorized.
